package: TO-252-2L (DPAK, 2 full leads + drain tab). Body 6.5-6.7 mm (D) x 6.0-6.2 mm (E), height 2.2-2.4 mm, lead pitch e = 2.186-2.386 mm; the centre lead is trimmed to an L4 = 0.6-1.0 mm stub, leaving two full L1 = 2.9 mm typ leads.
description: Wuxi NCE Power Semiconductor NCE01P13K - P-CHANNEL enhancement-mode power MOSFET, VDS = -100 V, ID = -13 A, RDS(ON) < 200 mohm at VGS = -10 V (typ 170 mohm). Advanced trench process, super high dense cell design, 'It is ESD protested' (sic - ESD protected; the Schematic diagram draws a gate-source zener clamp). 100% UIS tested and 100% dVds tested. Listed applications: power switch, DC/DC converters. ALL VOLTAGES AND CURRENTS ARE NEGATIVE - this is a P-channel device: to turn it on the gate must be pulled BELOW the source by more than |VGS(th)|. Source: NCE01P13K datasheet v1.0, catalogue information as of Sep. 2010, 7 pages.

pinout.name: G
pinout.notes: GATE - the LEFT lead in the 'Marking and pin assignment' TO-252-2L top view (labelled 'G'). VGS absolute maximum +/-20 V. VGS(th) = -1 V min / -1.9 V typ / -3 V max at VDS = VGS, ID = -250 uA, so the gate must be driven at least 3 V below the source to guarantee enhancement, and RDS(ON) is only specified at VGS = -10 V. Gate-body leakage IGSS <= +/-10 uA at VGS = +/-20 V. The datasheet does NOT number its pins; pin 1 = gate follows the standard TO-252 convention and matches KiCad Package_TO_SOT_SMD:TO-252-2 (pad 1 = the left lead, pad 2 = the tab, pad 3 = the right lead).

pinout.name: D
pinout.notes: DRAIN - the large TAB, and also the trimmed centre lead: the 'Marking and pin assignment' figure labels the tab 'D' at the top AND the short centre stub 'D' at the bottom, so the tab and the centre lead are the same node. This is the thermal path (RthJC = 3.13 C/W, Note 2: surface mounted on FR4 board, t <= 10 s). VDS = -100 V max; BVDSS <= -100 V min at VGS = 0 V, ID = -250 uA; IDSS <= 1 uA at VDS = -100 V. The drain tab therefore CARRIES THE FULL SWITCHED NODE - it is a large copper area at -100 V-class potential, so keep creepage/clearance and any heatsinking isolated accordingly.

pinout.name: S
pinout.notes: SOURCE - the RIGHT lead in the 'Marking and pin assignment' top view (labelled 'S'). Body-diode / source-drain diode polarity for a P-channel device: the intrinsic diode conducts from DRAIN to SOURCE (it is drawn in the Schematic diagram from the drain node up to the source node), VSD <= -1.2 V max at IS = -10 A, VGS = 0 V; IS = -13 A max, trr 35 ns typ, Qrr 46 nC typ at TJ = 25 C, IF = -10 A, di/dt = 100 A/us.

land_pattern.package: TO-252-2L - PACKAGE OUTLINE ONLY. This datasheet publishes NO recommended land pattern.
land_pattern.notes: NO LAND PATTERN IS PUBLISHED - page 6 'TO-252 Package Information' gives only the package outline (three views) and its min/max dimension table. pad_size_mm is therefore OMITTED. pitch_mm = 4.572 mm is DERIVED, not transcribed: the outline dimensions the lead pitch as e = 2.186 to 2.386 mm between ADJACENT lead centrelines (nominal 2.286), and because this is the 2L variant with the CENTRE lead trimmed to an L4 = 0.6-1.0 mm stub, the two solderable leads (gate and source) sit 2 x 2.286 = 4.572 mm apart. That is the nearest-neighbour pad-centre distance fp_verify will measure on a correct 3-pad TO-252 land, because the third pad is the big tab, farther away. CROSS-CHECK (not a datasheet statement): KiCad 10.0 Package_TO_SOT_SMD:TO-252-2 places pad 1 at (-5.04, -2.28) and pad 3 at (-5.04, +2.28) - 4.56 mm apart, 0.012 mm from the derived 4.572 and well inside the 0.05 mm tolerance - with pad 2 (the tab) at (1.26, 0) sized 6.4 x 5.8 mm. That footprint is compatible. FULL OUTLINE TABLE (page 6, min/max mm unless marked TYP): A 2.200/2.400 (height), A1 0.000/0.127 (standoff), b 0.660/0.860 (lead width), c 0.460/0.580 (lead thickness), D 6.500/6.700, D1 5.100/5.460, D2 4.830 TYP, E 6.000/6.200, e 2.186/2.386 (lead pitch), L 9.800/10.400 (overall including leads), L1 2.900 TYP (outer lead length), L2 1.400/1.700, L3 1.600 TYP, L4 0.600/1.000 (the trimmed centre-lead stub), PHI 1.100/1.300 (the tab mounting hole), theta 0 to 8 deg, h 0.000/0.300, V 5.350 TYP.

layout_notes: PIN 1 ORIENTATION: the TO-252-2L is asymmetric by construction - the DRAIN TAB is the whole top edge and the three lead positions are along the bottom edge of the 'Marking and pin assignment' top view: G (left, full lead), D (centre, trimmed stub, same node as the tab), S (right, full lead). Reading the body marking 'NCE01P13K' upright puts gate on the left. There is no dot or notch; orientation comes from the tab. A 180-degree rotation is mechanically impossible on a correct land (the tab pad is on one side only), but a MIRRORED footprint would swap gate and source - check that pad 1 is on the same side as the 'G' lead.

EXPOSED TAB = DRAIN, NOT GROUND. The tab is the drain and is the only meaningful heat path: RthJC = 3.13 C/W (Note 2: surface mounted on FR4 board, t <= 10 s). No RthJA is published anywhere. PD = 40 W and the derating factor 0.32 W/C are case-referenced (TC = 25 C) numbers and are unreachable on any realistic board copper - size the drain pour from RthJC plus your own board model, not from PD = 40 W.

GATE PROTECTION: the Schematic diagram draws a zener from gate to source alongside the MOSFET and its body diode, consistent with the description's 'It is ESD protested'. No clamp voltage, no gate resistance and no ESD class (HBM/CDM) is specified anywhere in the document.

DYNAMIC DATA IS 'GUARANTEED BY DESIGN, NOT SUBJECT TO PRODUCTION' (Note 4) and TYP-ONLY - there are no min/max limits on any capacitance, gate charge or switching time. Capacitances at VDS = -25 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1.0 MHz: Ciss 760 pF, Coss 260 pF, Crss 170 pF. Gate charge at VDS = -50 V, ID = -10 A, VGS = -10 V: Qg 25 nC, Qgs 5 nC, Qgd 7 nC. Switching at VDD = -50 V, ID = -10 A, VGS = -10 V, RGEN = 9.1 ohm: td(on) 14 ns, tr 18 ns, td(off) 50 ns, tf 18 ns. Crss = 170 pF is LARGE - this is a hot-swap/soft-start part, not a fast switch.

RDS(ON) IS ONLY SPECIFIED AT VGS = -10 V: 170 mohm typ / 200 mohm MAX at ID = -16 A (note the test current -16 A exceeds the -13 A continuous rating; it is a pulse test, Note 3: pulse width <= 300 us, duty <= 2%). There is NO logic-level (-4.5 V) RDS(ON) row, and with VGS(th) up to -3 V this part must NOT be driven from a 3.3 V rail. Figure 9 (normalised RDS(ON) vs VGS) and Figure 4 (vs TJ) are the only other on-resistance data.
CURRENT DERATING: ID = -13 A at TC = 25 C falls to -9.2 A at TC = 100 C (both case-referenced). Pulsed IDM = -30 A. Forward transconductance gFS >= 12 S at VDS = -15 V, ID = -5 A.

AVALANCHE: EAS = 110 mJ single pulse, Note 5 condition Tj = 25 C, VDD = -50 V, VG = -10 V, L = 0.5 mH, Rg = 25 ohm. Note 1 (repetitive rating) says pulse width is limited by maximum junction temperature.

NOT IN THIS DATASHEET: no recommended land pattern, no RthJA, no reflow profile, no MSL rating, no ESD class, no min/max on any dynamic parameter, no RDS(ON) below VGS = -10 V, and no packaging/reel data (the 'Package Marking and Ordering Information' table leaves Reel Size, Tape width and Quantity blank).

BOARD ROLE: DNP branch-B hot-swap on LUM-PAR-A. Even unstuffed, the drain tab's copper island and its clearance to neighbours must be laid out for the -100 V class rating, and the gate needs a defined pull-up to source (a P-FET with a floating gate is undefined).
